responsibility: Implements unpropagation of edge-created equivalences when copy/constant propagation would hinder coalescing. It discovers simple equivalences implied by conditional and switch edges, walks the dominator tree while maintaining stacks of active edge equivalences, and rewrites successor PHI operands from propagated constants/copies back to equivalent SSA names when those names can coalesce better with PHI results, improving later out-of-SSA code quality rather than performing a general optimization by itself.
